description.en: A Wheatstone bridge consists of four arms P, Q, R, and S. A galvanometer G is connected between B and D, and a battery between A and C. It is used to measure an unknown resistance accurately.
description.hi: व्हीटस्टोन सेतु में चार भुजाएं P, Q, R और S होती हैं। B और D के बीच एक धारामापी G और A और C के बीच एक बैटरी जुड़ी होती है। इसका उपयोग किसी अज्ञात प्रतिरोध को सटीक रूप से मापने के लिए किया जाता है।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 400 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Outer connecting wires -->
  <line x1="200" y1="250" x2="200" y2="220" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
  <line x1="200" y1="50" x2="200" y2="80" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
  <line x1="50" y1="150" x2="80" y2="150" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
  <line x1="350" y1="150" x2="320" y2="150" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- The Rhombus Arms (Resistors) -->
  <path d="M200,80 L140,115 L140,115 L200,80" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
  <path d="M80,150 L140,115" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
  <!-- Resistor zigzag (P) -->
  <path d="M200,80 L185,90 L195,100 L175,110 L185,120 L165,130 L175,140 L155,145 L140,115" fill="none" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="3" />
  <line x1="200" y1="80" x2="80" y2="150" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="3" />

  <!-- Simplified Resistors (Lines for P, Q, R, S) -->
  <line x1="200" y1="80" x2="80" y2="150" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="8,4" />
  <line x1="200" y1="80" x2="320" y2="150" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="8,4" />
  <line x1="80" y1="150" x2="200" y2="220" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="8,4" />
  <line x1="320" y1="150" x2="200" y2="220" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="8,4" />

  <!-- Galvanometer -->
  <line x1="200" y1="80" x2="200" y2="130" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2" />
  <line x1="200" y1="220" x2="200" y2="170" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2" />
  <circle cx="200" cy="150" r="20" fill="#f3f4f6" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2" />
  <!-- Galvanometer Arrow -->
  <line x1="200" y1="160" x2="210" y2="140" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2" />
  <polygon points="210,140 205,145 212,148" fill="#10b981" />

  <!-- Node Points -->
  <circle cx="200" cy="80" r="4" fill="#000" />
  <circle cx="200" cy="220" r="4" fill="#000" />
  <circle cx="80" cy="150" r="4" fill="#000" />
  <circle cx="320" cy="150" r="4" fill="#000" />
</svg>
